description: Post-v1 Fermat-quintic development campaign isolating k, D, progressive order, parameter scope, staged dictionary unfreezing, and an LR-only gentle path.

forbidden_inputs.policy: historical blind material is unavailable to all development commands

environment.precision: complex64 training; hash-bound complex128 development replay required before promotion
environment.note: Post-v1 environment; do not describe it as the frozen v1 PyTorch 2.5.1 environment.

scientific_policy.blind_policy: old 200k blind disabled; no blind creation or audit in this manifest
scientific_policy.promotion_policy: a separate create-only promotion manifest must freeze candidate hashes before generating a new blind pool; blind evaluation requires a later audit manifest
scientific_policy.d16_policy: core and joint resource/resume preflights only; any D16 accuracy phase requires a separate manifest after both gates pass and is outside the D14 estimand
scientific_policy.precision_claim_limit: complex64-trained development models; every A--J endpoint receives a hash-bound complex128 same-selection-point replay, validating forward metrics but not optimizer-trajectory equivalence

scientific.role: one complete forward/backward/Adam/QR/validation/checkpoint epoch; idempotent restart must reuse the hash-identical publication; interruption resume is test-certified
conditional one-epoch D16 memory gate with hash-identical idempotent reuse; no D16 accuracy estimand
complex128 forward replay on the unchanged 10k development selection pool
